correctness.rationale: Direct BP line-change Jacobian and exact interval cross-pair weight yield a normalized integral. Taylor differentiation at fixed hole radius, angular cancellation, and three exact elementary antiderivatives yield coefficient 5a/[pi(1-a^2)^(3/2)]. Fixed-a analyticity yields O_a(e^4), rotation gives the isotropic Hessian. Independent quadrature and point-pair segment tests passed.

value.rationale: The two-direction hole-location Hessian is the exact nondegenerate local stability law for a natural visibility-based convexity measure at fixed area and hole size. Its positive coefficient applies for every a in (0,1) and has singular thin-annulus scaling, not implied by existing concentric-radius formulas.
